comment: Persona matrix for Aturseva web-sim device testing. Adapted from pierridotite/mobile-agent-testers personas.json (MIT) for the RN-web simulation pipeline. Phase-2 fields (locale_render, rtl) are device-only — validated later on GitHub Actions runners.

personas.role: THE reference phone — the owner's actual device that exposed the bottom dead-band bug
personas.profile: Owner, tests every build personally on this exact phone.
personas.goal: Home fills the whole screen: no dead band above the nav pill, no cut labels.

personas.role: PRIMARY target user — Hindi belt shop owner on a small old phone
personas.profile: Shop owner, 44, reads Hindi, new to apps, careful with every button.
personas.goal: Understand what the app is for and finish one task without English.

personas.role: Large-text catcher — truncation bugs live here
personas.profile: Retired teacher, 68, low patience with jargon, uses large text.
personas.goal: Read every label fully; nothing cut, nothing ellipsized by force.

personas.profile: Retired nurse, 74, low vision, uses Android's largest font size (200%).
personas.goal: Read every screen and complete one task without zooming.

personas.profile: Student, 21, skips every text, taps fast, dark mode everywhere.
personas.goal: Reach the main feature as fast as possible; nothing unreadable in dark surroundings.
Judge whether the big screen is used well (centered phone column, not a balloon).
